newsitem.title: FRANCE: France may recapitalise Thomson pre-sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: France may recapitalise Thomson pre-sale - paper.

text.p: The French government will need to recapitalise debt-laden electronics and defence group Thomson SA before its privatisation, Les Echos financial daily said on Tuesday.
France's Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere Groupe on Monday both submitted bids to acquire the group, which is expected to be sold off before the end of the year.
A decision on a buyer, which is likely to go to President Jacques Chirac's office, should be known in early October, Les Echos reported.

"Despite turnover of 72 billion francs, experts say an initial valuation of Thomson SA before privatisation would be nil, or even a few billion francs in the red, because of net debt at 25 billion francs and shareholders' equity which is limited to 2.1 billion francs," Les Echos said.
This will force the state to recapitalise Thomson SA to sweeten the sale, the newspaper said. It did not say how much such a move might be worth.
The French finance ministry said on Monday the government wanted to privatise Thomson by the end of the year but declined all other comment.
